project.project_summary: [26.3 / April Fools] - Modpack that mainly tries to support snapshots with maximum performance, including Sodium. This includes minimal QoL mods.

version.changelog:
- Added [Better Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-block-entities), [ModernFix-mVUS](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix-mvus), and [More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling)
- Updated [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), [Fast IP Ping](https://modrinth.com/mod/fast-ip-ping), and [Ixeris](https://modrinth.com/mod/ixeris)
